title: DocsAgent configuration
description: Schema for ~/.docsagent/config.json. Both the C++ core and the MCP shells read this one file. Unknown keys are accepted and ignored.

coreHost.description: Address the shell dials and the core binds (0.0.0.0 = every interface, so other machines can reach it; use a LAN IP from a remote shell).

httpPort.description: Core HTTP port; the shell posts JSON-RPC to http://{coreHost}:{httpPort}/rpc.

coreBinary.description: Path to the DocsAgent Core binary used by 'docsagent start/stop/restart'. Empty = the platform binary bundled in bin/ (or a .js/.mjs entry run with node).

zoteroDataDir.description: Zotero data directory containing zotero.sqlite and storage/.

zoteroApiUrl.description: Zotero local API base URL used for write operations.

zoteroGroups.description: Group libraries synced by the shell via the Zotero Web API.

indexCheckInterval.description: Core incremental index check interval, seconds.

enableWrites.description: When false the three write tools are not registered at all.

httpListenAddr.description: Listen address in transport=streamable-http mode. Bind an internal interface only.

authMode.description: Remote mode authentication. oauth2 is reserved (not implemented yet).

authConfig.description: Auth settings. For api-key: { apiKey }. For oauth2 (reserved): issuer/audience settings.

rbacRoles.description: Role name -> list of allowed tool names. Reserved for remote mode.
